info.title: Fish Audio Universal API
info.description: Fish Audio is an AI voice generation platform for text-to-speech, speech-to-text, and custom voice model management.

visibility.description: Whether the model is public, unlisted, or private.

coverImage.description: Optional cover image. Required by Fish Audio when visibility is public.
